Citizens Park

Oval closure

Due to turf improvement works, access to the oval will not be permitted from 6am on Tuesday 15 September to 6am Thursday 1 October.

The oval is open for the public to use outside of the hours listed above. Lights will remain on from dusk until 10pm daily.

This schedule is subject to change and will be updated regularly to assist the wider community and dog walkers in planning their visits to Citizens Park.

On weekends, matches delayed by weather may be extended until 7:30pm at the latest.
